name: Exp_Delta_RSI
summary: This EA trades based on the Delta RSI indicator, which measures the difference between two RSI periods to detect momentum shifts. It enters long positions when the delta between fast and slow RSI crosses above a threshold and short positions when it crosses below. The strategy aims to capture momentum reversals before they become apparent on a single RSI reading.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Delta RSI指标进行交易，通过计算两个不同周期RSI的差值来捕捉动量变化。当快速RSI与慢速RSI的差值上穿阈值时做多，下穿时做空。策略旨在单一RSI无法显示的动量反转发生时尽早捕捉交易机会。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用Delta RSI（两个不同周期RSI的差值）来识别动量转折点。入场条件为：当快速RSI减去慢速RSI的差值从负转正并突破设定阈值时开多单，反之当差值从正转负并跌破负阈值时开空单。出场条件通常包括反向信号出现时平仓或达到止损/止盈目标。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金的仓位计算方式，允许用户通过参数调整每笔交易的风险敞口。资金管理上，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但具体是否强制设置取决于参数配置。该策略的优势在于能更敏感地捕捉动量变化，比单一RSI指标反应更快，但在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept uses Delta RSI (the difference between two RSI periods) to identify momentum turning points. Entry conditions are: a long position is opened when the fast RSI minus slow RSI delta crosses above a positive threshold, and a short position is opened when the delta crosses below a negative threshold. Exit conditions typically include closing on opposite signal generation or hitting stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a money-management-based calculation, with user-configurable risk exposure per trade. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters, though enforcement depends on the user's configuration. The strategy's advantage is faster sensitivity to momentum shifts compared to a single RSI, but it is prone to false signals in choppy markets leading to frequent losses.
pros: 双RSI差值设计比单一RSI更灵敏地捕捉动量转折
策略逻辑清晰简洁，参数可调性强便于优化
止损止盈配置完善，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Dual RSI delta design is more sensitive to momentum shifts than a single RSI
Clear and concise strategy logic with highly configurable parameters for optimization
Complete stop-loss and take-profit configuration provides a basic risk control framework
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器，可能在逆势中开仓
没有仓位加码或减码机制，资金管理灵活性不足
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks a trend filter, may open positions against the prevailing trend
No position scaling mechanism, limiting money management flexibility
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向）避免逆势交易
添加震荡市场识别机制（如ADX或ATR过滤）减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend entries
Add a choppy market detection mechanism (e.g., ADX or ATR filter) to reduce false signals

risk_points: 缺乏趋势过滤器可能在强趋势反转前逆势开仓
震荡市中Delta RSI频繁穿越阈值导致过度交易
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter may cause entries against strong trends before reversal
Delta RSI frequent threshold crossovers in choppy markets cause over-trading
